about_the_game:
UNBOXING Demo: Dive into this puzzle-platformer where death is your key to progress. In this free demo, solve 15+ challenging puzzles using your companion box to revive and navigate a strange, paradoxical world. Uncover the mystery of an endless cycle—can you break free?

  • 15+ Puzzles

  • 3 Unlockable Color Palettes

Think out of the box in this intriguing demo experience!
